+		name    string
+		options []containers.Option[StoreOptions]

+			dir := testRepository(t)
+			ref, err := ParseReference("flipt://local/" + repo + ":latest")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			store, err := NewStore(zaptest.NewLogger(t), dir, tc.options...)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			files, err := fs.Sub(testdata, "testdata")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			_, err = store.Build(ctx, files, ref)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			target, err := store.getTarget(ref)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			desc, err := target.Resolve(ctx, "latest")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			reader, err := target.Fetch(ctx, desc)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer reader.Close()

+		name    string
+		options []containers.Option[StoreOptions]
+		version string
+	}{
+		{name: "default 1.1", version: "1.1"},
+		{name: "configured 1.0", options: []containers.Option[StoreOptions]{WithManifestVersion(oras.PackManifestVersion1_0)}, version: "1.0"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			dir := testRepository(t)
+			ref, err := ParseReference("flipt://local/" + repo + ":latest")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			store, err := NewStore(zaptest.NewLogger(t), dir, tc.options...)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			files, err := fs.Sub(testdata, "testdata")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			_, err = store.Build(ctx, files, ref)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			target, err := store.getTarget(ref)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			desc, err := target.Resolve(ctx, "latest")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			reader, err := target.Fetch(ctx, desc)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer reader.Close()
+			var manifest v1.Manifest
+			require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(reader).Decode(&manifest))
+			if tc.version == "1.0" {

+			} else {
+				assert.Equal(t, MediaTypeFliptFeatures, manifest.ArtifactType)
+				assert.Equal(t, v1.MediaTypeEmptyJSON, manifest.Config.MediaType)
+			}
+		})
+	}
